workers.name: Codex independent Jinshi 029 source date auditor

summary: Complete independent initial audit of all 256 Chinese ritual-protocol units, all 31 temporal or active-hint items, and all eight person records. The dated Jin court rites are retained at their stated conventional years: Tianhui 4 is AD 1126, Tianjuan 2 AD 1139, Dading 2/15/18 AD 1162/1175/1178, and Mingchang 6 AD 1195. The four legendary cult recipients are not thereby living in AD 1195: the source dates an annual sacrifice instituted under Zhangzong, not Fuxi, Nüwa, Jiang Yuan, or Jiandi. Their life-activity hints therefore require repair; all four related ritual-reception claims themselves remain source-supported when read as cult-recipient events.

findings.problem: The active-date summaries for Fuxi, Nüwa, Jiang Yuan, and Jiandi convert an AD 1195 court cult date into personal activity, although the source identifies them only as recipients of the annual Gaomei sacrifice.
findings.action: Remove the four AD 1195 active-date hints only. Retain the source-supported dated cult-recipient claims, explicitly understood as posthumous or legendary reception rather than life chronology.
